web-child-safety.494a84c6dc58edce:
("we") — operated by Ava Global International, Inc., a Delaware
    corporation — has zero
    tolerance for child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE) on our service. This page sets out the
    standards we hold ourselves to, how we enforce them, and how to report a concern.
web-child-safety.0ef9f6fe4039be84:
Child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and any content or conduct that sexualises a minor are
      strictly prohibited, without exception.
web-child-safety.02b5c863bb02f8ef:
Grooming, sextortion, solicitation of minors, and trafficking are prohibited and are
      reported to the relevant authorities.
web-child-safety.0827dd8b1b942c76:
Saathum is not intended for children under 13. Accounts we identify as belonging to
      under-13 users are removed.
web-child-safety.3846ed3ef52d02bf:
Creating, uploading, sending, storing, requesting, or linking to CSAM in any format,
      including AI-generated or computer-drawn depictions.
web-child-safety.f494c307d0560f51:
Sexualising a minor in text, images, audio, video, profile details, group names, or status
      posts.
web-child-safety.a761cd7253dfcc8d:
Contacting a minor for sexual purposes, or attempting to establish contact for that
      purpose.
web-child-safety.9db13b6cb3b15ed6: Threatening to share a minor's intimate imagery, or coercing a minor into producing it.
web-child-safety.e7ab8bcf82abf541: Facilitating, promoting, or advertising any of the above, including off-platform.
web-child-safety.4fd86a5e2b2af906:
, which
    apply to everything on Saathum.
web-child-safety.dbfb724648ea599a:
Users can report a conversation or an account from
      within the app, and can email us at any time. Reports flagged as child safety concerns are
      routed to a priority queue.
web-child-safety.3a83fa13e17e5a70:
Users can block any account immediately, which stops all calls
      and messages from it.
web-child-safety.209be9f00f8e29b7:
Reports are reviewed by our safety team. Confirmed CSAE
      violations result in immediate and permanent account termination, preservation of the
      relevant evidence, and removal of the offending content.
web-child-safety.e2b631f8268a3646:
Confirmed CSAM is reported to the National
      Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) and to law enforcement in the relevant
      jurisdiction, as applicable law requires.
web-child-safety.6cc388c1af5a7ccc:
We take steps to prevent terminated accounts from
      returning to the service.
web-child-safety.faaba2a5a3afd734:
Some Saathum content is private to the participants. Where content is not accessible to us, we
    act on user reports, account-level signals, and metadata, and we preserve and disclose what we
    lawfully hold when required by valid legal process. Our enforcement against reported accounts
    does not depend on our ability to read message content.
web-child-safety.5559eea079077c38: If you believe a child is being harmed on Saathum, report it in the app or contact us directly.
web-child-safety.29831d1c2989ab1a: If a child is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first.
web-child-safety.f3ff6d49bc1573cc: Ava Global International, Inc., Delaware, United States
web-child-safety.c20a13e321c52c20:
These standards are published in line with Google Play's Child Safety Standards policy and are
    reviewed regularly. We comply with applicable child protection law in the jurisdictions where
    Saathum is available.
